metadata.title: [FIX][UI]: Preserve team_id in delete/toggle redirect URLs
metadata.author: madhav165

description:
# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

Fixes #3267

## Summary

- Fixes delete and toggle operations dropping `team_id` from redirect URLs, which caused users to lose their team-scoped view
- Adds `_build_admin_redirect()` helper in `admin.py` to centralize redirect URL construction with `error`, `include_inactive`, and `team_id` parameters
- Moves `team_id` form injection from `handleDeleteSubmit()` into `handleToggleSubmit()` so both toggle and delete paths include team context

## Details

### Backend (`mcpgateway/admin.py`)

- New `_build_admin_redirect()` helper replaces ~150 lines of duplicated redirect logic across 14 endpoints
- Extracts `team_id` from form data and includes it in the redirect URL
- Validates `team_id` through `_normalize_team_id()` (UUID check) before including it
- Uses `urllib.parse.urlencode(quote_via=urllib.parse.quote)` to maintain `%20` encoding consistent with existing patterns

**Endpoints updated:**
- `admin_set_server_state`, `admin_delete_server` (catalog tab)
- `admin_set_gateway_state`, `admin_delete_gateway` (gateways tab)
- `admin_delete_tool`, `admin_set_tool_state` (tools tab)
- `admin_delete_resource`, `admin_set_resource_state` (resources tab)
- `admin_delete_prompt`, `admin_set_prompt_state` (prompts tab)
- `admin_add_root`, `admin_update_root`, `admin_delete_root` (roots tab)
- `admin_set_a2a_agent_state`, `admin_delete_a2a_agent` (a2a-agents tab)

### Frontend (`mcpgateway/static/admin.js`)

- Moved `team_id` injection from `handleDeleteSubmit()` into `handleToggleSubmit()` with a guard (`!form.querySelector(...)`) to prevent duplicates
- Both toggle and delete paths now include `team_id` in form data

## Test plan

- [x] All 873 existing admin tests pass
- [x] All redirect-specific tests pass
- [x] Verify on admin UI: toggle a tool on a team-scoped page, confirm redirect preserves `?team_id=`
- [x] Verify on admin UI: delete a tool on a team-scoped page, confirm redirect preserves `?team_id=`
- [x] Verify on admin UI: operations without team scope still redirect correctly (no empty `team_id=` param)
- [x] Verify error redirects also preserve team scope

commits.message:
[FIX][UI]: Preserve team_id in delete/toggle redirect URLs

Delete and toggle operations dropped the team_id query parameter from
redirect URLs, causing the browser to land on the unscoped admin page
instead of the team-scoped view. Edit worked because it built the
redirect client-side.

- Add _build_admin_redirect() helper to construct redirect URLs with
  error, include_inactive, and team_id query parameters
- Update all delete/toggle/state endpoints to use the helper
- Move team_id form injection from handleDeleteSubmit into
  handleToggleSubmit so both code paths include it

Signed-off-by: Madhav Kandukuri <madhav165@gmail.com>

commits.message:
review: remove dead code, fix imports, add team_id redirect tests

- Remove unreachable `or ""` fallback in _build_admin_redirect
  (_normalize_team_id never returns None when team_id is truthy)
- Fix import ordering in test_admin.py (isort)
- Add comprehensive unit tests for _build_admin_redirect helper
  covering all parameter combinations and edge cases
- Add integration tests verifying team_id flows through endpoints:
  admin_delete_server, admin_set_tool_state, admin_delete_root,
  admin_delete_a2a_agent, admin_set_a2a_agent_state
- Verify invalid team_id is silently dropped from redirect URLs
- Achieve 100% differential test coverage for all new code

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
